questions.stem: Will copper react with zinc sulfate solution?

options.text: Yes, because all metals react with sulfate solutions
Yes, because copper is more reactive than zinc
No, because zinc sulfate is insoluble
No, because copper is less reactive than zinc and cannot displace it

questions.explanation: Copper will not react with zinc sulfate solution because copper is below zinc in the reactivity series. A less reactive metal cannot displace a more reactive metal from its compound, so no reaction occurs.
